title: Record the two selected row readings
body:
## Summary
- The gauge pairs give 9909 and 252. The frozen assembler adds the prefix term 2*512 = 1024, so the constant degrees total 11185.
- The orthogonal order with live width 14336 has row-bit length 2642. The published readings are 2*2642+11185 = 16469 and ceil(43*2642/26)+11185 = 15555. Both stay under the cap 20161.
- No new kappa. The fourteen stage headrooms stay unrecomputed.
